name: ANSI/IEEE numbered terminal symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented numbered connection-point form, with public vendor evidence and terminal-reading notes.
description: A numbered terminal form provides an identifiable wiring interface whose connection path is followed through the terminal plan. The number distinguishes the connection point; it does not describe every physical feature of the terminal body.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Match the terminal number to both conductor destinations.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A numbered schematic terminal is not a dimensional terminal-block footprint.
